svg.text: Raspberry Pi Pico · 16 keys · 0.96" SSD1306 OLED (I2C) · 10k potentiometer. Same-name labels are connected.
One leg to its GP pin, the other leg to GND.
Chain all 16 GND legs together, then to any GND pin.
No diodes or resistors needed (internal pull-ups).
Menu LED = the Pico's onboard LED (GP25). Nothing to wire.
Power comes from USB. Small numbers are physical pin numbers.
